# Agent evaluation, 2026-11-28 (claude-sonnet-5-5)

57 sessions of model `claude-sonnet-5-5` (effort: the model's default; at most 20 turns each) on the project P-eval (sha256 c6b11319dc9ddef54821abd71102b34d520037311cd8aadc1b1f8018d7ce597c). Each session gives the model one task and an MCP connection to a fresh headless engine; a checker then reads the final document and says pass or fail. How to run it and how to read this page: [agent-eval.md](../agent-eval.md). The numbers and every tool call are in `2026-11-28-claude-sonnet-5-5.json`.

Input and output tokens are the API's own counts (usage). Tokens of tool results and of tool definitions are estimates: bytes of the text or JSON divided by 4, rounded up.

One run of a model is one sample: a difference of a call or a few percent between two variants is within what a second run would change.
